source: live OpenRouter review of actual native Docker FEMM mesh
prompt: Create a new 2D planar DC magnetostatic model. All coordinates and dimensions are in millimeters. Use out-of-plane depth 10 mm. Draw an asymmetric C-shaped steel polygon, vertices in order (-15,-12), (10,-12), (10,-6), (-7,-6), (-7,6), (6,6), (6,12), (-15,12), relative permeability 1000, label (-12,0). Add winding rectangles (-5,-4) to (0,4), label (-2.5,0), +50 turns, and (-22,-4) to (-17,4), label (-19.5,0), -50 turns. Both windings have relative permeability 1 and share a +1 A DC circuit. Use enclosing air rectangle (-40,-30) to (30,30), outer A=0, background label (20,20), and B probe (3,0). Use global mesh size 1 mm. No force extraction is requested.

quality.aspect_definition: longest edge divided by its altitude (equilateral: 2/sqrt(3))

checks.name: native_artifacts
checks.detail: Finite 2D nodes, indexed three-node elements, unique triangles and consistent edges.

checks.name: element_geometry
checks.detail: Every element has positive area; each internal edge has two incident triangles on opposite sides.

checks.name: domain_coverage
checks.detail: Nodes lie inside the domain; one closed outer boundary and the expected filled area are present.

checks.name: block_labels
checks.detail: Every compiler block-label index is present and covers its intended label seed.

warnings: Mesh structure and element shape were inspected. Mesh-refinement and outer-boundary convergence have not been verified.

review.summary: The geometry and region assignments appear consistent with the source request. The C-shaped core and two winding rectangles are correctly positioned relative to each other. The probe location and domain boundaries match the specifications.

limitation: One advisory example; no numerical convergence certification.
